workflows.title: Create or edit a page
workflows.description: Build a LiveCanvas page or change a scoped section using the verified theme and asset pipeline.

workflows.title: Edit a shared component
workflows.description: Inspect and change LiveCanvas partials, headers, footers, blocks and sections with explicit shared impact.

workflows.title: Build a single or archive template
workflows.description: Resolve the effective LiveCanvas Dynamic Template or child-theme fallback before changing a single or archive layout.

workflows.title: Manage assets and compile styles
workflows.description: Use WordPress media and the actual Tailwind/WindPress, Bootstrap/Sass or theme-native build pipeline.

workflows.title: Verify or restore a change
workflows.description: Check saved, compiled, rendered and published states separately; compare a reference and detect conflicts before restoration.
